correctness.rationale: Exact 13-orbit symbolic computation yields the 3-cube sharp coefficient, with all rational cuts checked and analytic sign-interval proof supplied. Layer-cake reduces all real signals to cuts. The monotonicity in dimension follows by lifting to an unused coordinate, and global cutoff follows from Hellinger lower and chi-square/Dobrushin upper bounds. The single-site Gaussian Gini profile follows from a bounded-second-moment lognormal limit; no global critical-window equality is asserted.

value.rationale: The three-bit exact coefficient and strict dimension threshold quantify a natural non-Hilbert stability loss, and the high-dimensional transition rigorously identifies when the full Gini seminorm loses effective contraction, even as each nonconstant Walsh coefficient shrinks. The explicit Gaussian profile of a canonical attaining single-site ratio at finite dimension gives a nontrivial quantitative benchmark for the unresolved full-norm critical window.
